notes: Fixes the Roon to Spotify crash: an OutOfMemoryError, reported by 0.2.4 rather than killing the app silently. Reading the target's saved albums held every page of raw JSON at once, and Spotify's /me/albums sends the full album object with about 180 country codes on the album and on every track — some 15KB apiece. 187MB for 1,500 albums in a test, against a 256MB heap on the phone, and the run died before matching anything. Both pagers in both clients now map each page as they go and drop the JSON, so a walk holds one page instead of a library.
